Linux x86_64 WSL · input rows and request wall µs, both log scale · three independent rounds per point
Filled dots: original retained cohort; hollow dots: extension. No repeated point is pooled across cohorts. Ranges: round min–max.
Predicate-dominated generated input, not an arithmetic-heavy workload.

Kernel-only excludes input construction/validation, Tools, output and async dispatch. Full-request includes them. Rust/asm are fixed-fixture floors.
Ordinary runtimes differ in object representation, arithmetic, lifecycle and authority. Curves do not establish general Python or sandbox equivalence.
